bio: A fourth-generation century-old restaurant founded by great-grandmother Jesusa in 1923 which takes its name from a small island nearby. It features a private dining space, two elegant dining rooms and an open-view kitchen, where experienced chef Miguel Ángel Campos focuses on traditional cuisine with touches of creativity, including an impressive selection of seafood and the restaurant’s signature dishes (gratin of turbot with greens, and pan-fried sole with cornflour). A welcoming terrace completes the picture....
